lines.zh: 叶面有一层细绒，抓得稳。
lines.en: The leaf's fine nap gives my feet a grip.

lines.zh: 身体一拱一拱地往前挪。
lines.en: My body arches and stretches forward.
Many feet, stepping in a tight rhythm.
I follow the vein in a straight line.

lines.zh: 叶子的边太近了，我绕回来。
lines.en: The leaf edge is close; I turn back.

lines.zh: 我咬出一个缺口，再往前。
lines.en: I bite a notch and move on.
I stop and lift my front end.

lines.zh: 叶子挨着叶子，我直接过去。
lines.en: Leaf touches leaf, so I cross straight over.
I shift slowly to the underside.
My fine hairs brush the leaf.
Hind legs brace, front legs reach.

lines.zh: 这一整片够我吃到结蛹。
lines.en: This whole leaf will feed me until I pupate.
I keep away from the gap at the edge.
I cling to the leaf and creep.
I raise my head to find the next leaf.

lines.zh: 嘴里的叶渣还没咽下去。
lines.en: There's still leaf mash in my mouth.
I lie still on the leaf.
The vein ridges under me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢嚼着嘴里的一小口。
lines.en: I chew a small mouthful slowly.

lines.zh: 阳光透过叶子，绿得发亮。
lines.en: Sunlight through the leaf glows green.
The wind sways the leaf.
I draw myself in a little.
My fine hairs stand up.
It's safe here where I am.
I look slowly left and right.

lines.zh: 叶面上有别的虫咬过的痕。
lines.en: There are bite marks from other insects.
I shift to make room.

lines.zh: 我等这片叶子再长一点。
lines.en: I'll wait for this leaf to grow.

lines.zh: 我从叶缘探出半截身子。
lines.en: I lean half my body out over the leaf's edge.
Your shadow falls on the leaf.
You're much bigger than the leaf.
I hold still and pass for a vein.

lines.zh: 我一点点退回叶脉后面。
lines.en: I inch back behind the midrib.
You're not a leaf.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛离我只有一掌。
lines.en: Your eye is a hand's width from me.
You might step on this leaf.
I grip the leaf.

lines.zh: 我钻到叶子背面藏起来。
lines.en: I crawl under the leaf and hide.
The pain ties my body in a knot.
I squirm to get away.
My skin is broken.
I fall off the leaf.
I crawl slowly back onto the leaf.

lines.zh: 这一下让我半身都麻了。
lines.en: The blow leaves half of me numb.
I've bitten a mark into the leaf.
Dirt and blood cling to me.
I want to hide under the leaf.
I can still squirm, not dead yet.
This leaf is tender.

lines.zh: 你放下的叶子，我能吃吗？
lines.en: Can I eat the leaf you set down?

lines.zh: 我朝那片嫩叶挪了半尺。
lines.en: I move half a foot toward that tender leaf.
First I nibble off the tenderest corner.
Tastes good.
Another bite.
I'm eating faster now.
Don't touch me.
This will feed me a while.
I move to the other end of the leaf.
The bump rolls me off the leaf.
I land on the ground, writhing.

lines.zh: 叶子不是我的落脚处了。
lines.en: The leaf is no longer my footing.
I hurry back.
The shock presses me flat against the leaf.
Dirt clings to me.
I crawl slowly to the leaf edge.

lines.zh: 细毛上沾的土被我抖落。
lines.en: The dirt on my bristles shakes loose.
It stings a little.
I slip to the leaf's underside, legs still hooked on.
There's a kin's scent nearby.
We approach slowly.
Our bodies touch.
Afterward we each crawl away.
I'll leave eggs on the leaf.
There's enough leaf for them.
I find a bigger leaf.
It's quiet here.
The leaf is still growing.
I crawl slowly back to the vein.

lines.zh: 三对脚一起搂住这粒东西。
lines.en: Three pairs of legs clutch the morsel.

lines.zh: 这块东西比我整条身子长。
lines.en: This thing is longer than my whole body.
I can't drag it.
Too hard.

lines.zh: 我用头顶着它挪了半寸。
lines.en: I push it half an inch with my head.
It's stuck in a vein.
I crawl around it.
The leaf is what I want.
I keep chewing the leaf.
I sniff. Not a leaf.
The leaf is moving.

lines.zh: 这不是风，叶子在被人碰。
lines.en: Not wind; something is touching the leaf.
I lift my front half off the leaf.

lines.zh: 我听见叶子外有呼吸声。
lines.en: I hear breathing beyond the leaf.
I press close to the leaf.
I crawl downward.
The underside is darker.
I'll wait for it to leave.
It passed right over my head.
I shrink back toward the midrib.
It's still over there.
I don't move.
The leaf edge is right here.
One more step and I fall.
I go another way.
The vein gives some cover.
It stops two steps away and holds still.
If it doesn't move, I keep chewing.
This leaf is still mine.

lines.zh: 我把嚼叶的声音压到最小。
lines.en: I chew as quietly as I can.

lines.zh: 我弓起背，猛地弹它一下。
lines.en: I arch my back and flick at it.
I raise my head and butt.
I gnaw once at its leg.
This much force is nothing.
All I can do is squirm.
I land on the leaf below.
I crawl away quickly.
I'm covered in dirt.
I hide under the leaf.
I twist my head to bite it.
The eggshell splits and my head comes out.
First thing: find a leaf.
The leaf is right here.
The first mouthful of leaf sap is sweet.
I'm still very small.
First I chew myself a little path.
The jungle is all green.
I find a tender leaf.
I stop and eat.
This is enough to grow on.

lines.zh: 叶子烧起来，我拼命往下爬。
lines.en: The leaf burns and I scramble down.
I hit the ground and my body goes slack.
Water wraps me and I can't squirm.
The blast sweeps me off the leaf.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉进叶面，就在我旁边。
lines.en: An arrow bites the leaf beside me.
Light numbs me all over.
No leaves left, and I weaken.
Lightning flashes and my body stiffens.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，什么也抓不住。
lines.en: I fall, nothing to hold.
